h1: BeWish Residence Bangphlat — Budget Recovery Stay Near Yanhee with Microwave & Fridge in Every Room
intro: If you or someone you care about is recovering from surgery at Yanhee International Hospital and needs a clean, practical place to rest without stretching the budget, BeWish Residence Bangphlat is the name that comes up most often on Soi Charan Sanitwong 84 · it sits just 600 m from Yanhee — a 4-minute drive · every room comes with a microwave, fridge, kettle and a private balcony, so you can heat food and store medication without having to leave · prices start from around ฿700/night, the lowest in the immediate area · scored 9.0 from 84 Trip.com reviews, which is impressive at this price point

body.html: Who BeWish Residence is for — to be straight about it, this place is not designed as a leisure hotel with a fancy lobby or resort-style facilities. It is a small serviced apartment built around a simple proposition: a clean, safe room with an in-room kitchen and free parking, as close to Yanhee Hospital as you can get at an affordable price · BeWish Residence is at 41/1 Soi Charan Sanitwong 84, Bang O, Bang Phlat — on the Thonburi side of Bangkok, 600 m from Yanhee International Hospital · the core audience is patients having cosmetic surgery or gender-affirming procedures at Yanhee who need somewhere to recover for several days to several weeks, and the family or friends accompanying them · the starting price of around THB 700/night makes it the lowest-cost option among recovery stays near Yanhee, and that is its main draw · if you are looking for a pool, a breakfast buffet, and 4-star service levels, this is not the place — but if you want a clean room with a working kitchen and good security a short ride from the hospital, BeWish does that better than most at this price

Location and distance to Yanhee International Hospital — this is the heart of why people choose this property · BeWish Residence is 600 m from Yanhee International Hospital, which works out to around 4 minutes by car according to the local proximity data for this area · in practice, patients call a Grab or hail a motorbike taxi from the front of the property to reach Yanhee easily at any hour — the fare is only a few dozen baht, which matters when you are making multiple follow-up visits for dressing changes or check-ups · the 600 m is a bit far to walk comfortably after most surgical procedures, but short enough that transport is trivially cheap · for public transport, MRT Bang O and MRT Bang Phlat are both around 650–670 m away, about an 8–9 minute walk — they connect to central Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport without any change · there is no hotel-operated hospital shuttle on record, but the Grab network in this area is reliable around the clock · the streets around the soi have convenience stores, food stalls, and small eateries within easy walking distance — useful when you need to pick up ready-to-eat meals to heat in your room

"The room was very clean, and having a fridge and microwave was a lifesaver during recovery — I could heat food without having to go out · the security system and free parking were great, and I always felt safe · the staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay"

Rooms and in-room amenities — BeWish Residence has around 20 rooms, with the main type being the Superior Double (one King bed) · what guests mention most in reviews is that every room comes with a microwave, a fridge, an electric kettle and a private balcony — a combination that is genuinely important for a recovery patient who needs to heat food, keep medication refrigerated, or store cool drinks without leaving the room · rooms also have air conditioning, a flat-screen smart TV, free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom, a work desk, a sitting area, and a wardrobe · several reviews praise the room size as good for the price and the natural light from the balcony · the decor is simple and functional rather than design-forward, which is perfectly in keeping with the recovery-stay use case · one thing to note up front: although the building has a lift, if you are checking in immediately after surgery and mobility will be limited, ask specifically for a low-floor room when booking — the lift helps but minimising any walking distance from the lift to your door is worth the request

Shared facilities and security — for a property at this price level, what is here is well matched to what recovery patients actually need · free private parking is available on site, which is very useful for families driving patients to and from the hospital · 24-hour security staff and key-fob building access are both flagged positively across reviews — guests repeatedly say they felt safe throughout their stay · there is a lift, a front desk, laundry services, and free Wi-Fi throughout the building · there is no pool, no gym, and no on-site breakfast — but these are things most post-surgery patients do not use, and the in-room microwave and fridge cover what matters most · a convenience store and food options are close enough to the entrance of the soi that you can pick up supplies with a short walk or a quick motorbike-taxi ride

Pricing and when to book — the standard Superior Double starts at around THB 700–800/night during quieter periods, rising to roughly THB 1,000–1,200/night at peak times — for example when Yanhee has long surgery queues (typically around January and November–December) · even at the higher end this is cheaper than most alternatives at a similar distance from the hospital · the building rents some units on a monthly basis to long-term residents as well, and if you are planning a recovery of several weeks it is worth calling the property directly to ask whether a longer-stay rate is available · prices can vary between Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com on the same night, so a quick comparison before booking is worthwhile

Real guest feedback — the good and the honest — across more than 84 reviews on Trip.com (score 9.0) and other platforms the picture is consistent · what guests praise: very clean rooms; having a microwave and fridge made recovery much more comfortable; excellent location for Yanhee patients; free parking; strong 24-hour security; friendly and helpful staff; quiet atmosphere that lets you sleep well · what guests flag: no breakfast on site, so you need to buy or heat your own food (most patients consider this a minor inconvenience given the in-room microwave) · some reviews mention that room doors or corridor doors can be noisy when opening and closing, which may disturb light sleepers in adjacent rooms · a handful of reviewers noted some corridor noise from neighbouring rooms — requesting a room away from the lift lobby can reduce this · and a few guests mentioned a one-time overbooking issue, though this appears isolated rather than a pattern

"Cheap, clean, and the microwave meant I could heat the food I bought from the shop around the corner without any hassle · the Grab to Yanhee took about 5 minutes and cost almost nothing · I would definitely come back for my next follow-up visit"

The honest bottom line for Yanhee recovery patients — BeWish Residence Bangphlat is the best-value option for patients recovering at Yanhee on a tight budget · a clean room with a microwave and fridge, 24-hour security and key-fob access, free parking for the family car, and a 600 m link to the hospital add up to everything a basic recovery stay actually needs · the absence of a pool, gym, and breakfast is a non-issue for most people who have just had surgery · the main things to plan around are: arrange your own transport for the 600 m to Yanhee (Grab or motorbike taxi), pick up food from nearby shops to heat in your room, and book early during busy periods when the hospital schedule fills up · if your recovery requires more comfort — a spacious room with an indoor pool, or a riverside setting to rest in — Beyond Suite Hotel or WE Hotel Riverfront are both within the same area at a higher price point

tips.title: Request a low-floor room before surgery day
tips.body: Even with a lift, a room on floors 1–2 means less walking when you are at your least mobile. Mention this when you book or call the property directly.

tips.title: Stock the fridge before your procedure
tips.body: The convenience store and food stalls are a short walk from the soi. Buy ready-to-eat meals and drinks the day before surgery so everything is waiting in the room when you need it.

tips.title: Use Grab rather than walking to Yanhee
tips.body: 600 m feels much longer after most procedures. A Grab or motorbike taxi from the property reaches Yanhee in about 5 minutes and costs very little — far easier than walking.

tips.title: Book early during Yanhee's busy seasons
tips.body: When Yanhee's surgery schedule fills up — typically November through January — rooms at this property fill quickly. Compare prices across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com and book ahead with a free-cancellation rate if your dates are not yet confirmed.

faq.q: How far is BeWish Residence from Yanhee International Hospital?
faq.a: BeWish Residence is at 41/1 Soi Charan Sanitwong 84, Bang Phlat, approximately 600 m from Yanhee International Hospital — around a 4-minute drive. A Grab or motorbike taxi is available around the clock at a very low fare.

faq.q: Does BeWish Residence have a microwave and fridge in the room?
faq.a: Yes. Every room has a microwave, a fridge and an electric kettle, along with a private balcony. This is one of the main reasons recovery patients choose this property — you can heat food and store medication without leaving your room.

faq.q: How much does BeWish Residence cost per night?
faq.a: The Superior Double starts from around THB 700–800/night during quieter periods, rising to roughly THB 1,000–1,200/night at peak times (e.g. when Yanhee's schedule is heaviest). This is the lowest starting price of any recovery-stay option near Yanhee. Compare rates on Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Is there a lift at BeWish Residence?
faq.a: Yes, the building has a lift. If you are checking in immediately after surgery and your mobility will be limited, request a low-floor room at the time of booking so you have the shortest possible walk from the lift to your room.

faq.q: Is BeWish Residence suitable for post-surgery recovery?
faq.a: It is well suited to patients recovering after cosmetic surgery or gender-affirming procedures at Yanhee on a budget. The in-room microwave and fridge, 24-hour security, free parking, lift, and 600 m distance from the hospital cover the essentials. The main limitations are no breakfast and no pool.

faq.q: Which MRT station is closest to BeWish Residence?
faq.a: Both MRT Bang O (650 m) and MRT Bang Phlat (670 m) are about an 8–9 minute walk from the property. Either station connects to central Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport on the Blue Line.
